        expect(panel["mode"] == "offer" and panel["text"] == VOLUME_NEEDS
               and panel["message"] == OFFER_LINE
               and panel["buttons"] == ["open_practice", "close"],
               f"the offer: {panel}")
        self.press("open_practice")
        got = self.settled()
        expect(got.get("running") and got.get("id") == "audio.volume"
               and got.get("step") in (1, 2) and got["panel"]["mode"] == "step",
               f"after open_practice: running {got.get('running')} {got.get('id')} step "
               f"{got.get('step')} panel {got['panel']['mode']}")
        clips = self.call("get_project")["project"]["clips"]
        expect(len(clips) == 3, f"the front project holds {len(clips)} clips, not the copy's 3")
        return f"offered, then the practice copy runs audio.volume at step {got['step']}"

    def c2(self):
        self.close_all()
        self.start("canvas.add_title")
        dump, _ = self.capture("tutorial", "c2-offer")
        text = [v["text"] for v in dump.shown("tutorial.text")]
        buttons = [v["id"] for v in dump.views
                   if (v["id"] or "").startswith("tutorial.") and v["class"] == "StickerButton"
                   and not v["hidden"]]
        expect(text == [NO_WINDOW], f"the offer's text {text}")
        expect(buttons == ["tutorial.open_practice", "tutorial.close"],
               f"the offer's buttons {buttons}")
        self.press("close")
        kinds = self.kinds()
        expect("tutorial" not in kinds, f"after close the listing holds {kinds}")
        return "offered with no window; Close took the panel down"

    def e1(self):
        self.start("audio.volume")
        self.settled()
        before = self.call("get_project")
        self.press("exit")
        got = self.state()
        kinds = self.kinds()
        after = self.call("get_project")
        expect(got.get("running") is False, "still running after exit")
        expect("tutorial" not in kinds and "spotlight" not in kinds, f"listing {kinds}")

    def e2(self):

        self.settled()
        self.call("close_project", discard=True)
        kinds = self.kinds()
        expect("tutorial" not in kinds and "spotlight" not in kinds, f"listing {kinds}")

    def f1(self):

        self.press("show_me")
        self.settled()

               f"tutorial rows {rows}")
        return "the panel is neither key nor main after a press"

    def s_row(self):

        panel, ppath = self.capture("tutorial", "s-panel")
        editor, epath = self.capture("editor", "s-editor")
        for path in (ppath, epath):

            first = bytes(rows[0][:channels])

                          for r in rows for i in range(0, len(r), channels))
            expect(not uniform, f"{path.name} is one colour")
        expect(panel.result.get("problems") == [], f"panel problems {panel.result.get('problems')}")
        expect(panel.result.get("appearance") == self.look,
               f"panel appearance {panel.result.get('appearance')}")
        expect(editor.shown("tutorial.spotlight"), "the editor capture holds no staged ring")
        return f"{ppath.name} and {epath.name} not uniform; the panel {self.look}, no problems"

    # ---- all ----

    def light(self, only):
        def wanted(rid):
            return not only or rid in only

        if wanted("H1"):
            self.row("H1", self.h1, opener=None)
        if wanted("K1"):
            self.row("K1", self.k1)
        for page in self.pages:
            for t in page["tutorials"]:
                rid = f"M-{t['id']}"
                if wanted(rid):
                    self.row(rid, lambda tid=t["id"]: self.m_row(tid))
        table = [("TK1", self.tk1, "practice"), ("W1", self.w1, "practice"),
                 ("C1", self.c1, "empty"), ("C2", self.c2, None), ("E1", self.e1, "practice"),
                 ("E2", self.e2, "practice"), ("F1", self.f1, "practice"),
                 ("S1", self.s_row, "practice")]
        for rid, body, opener in table:
            if wanted(rid):
                self.row(rid, body, opener)

    def dark(self, only):
        if not only or "S2" in only:
            self.row("S2", self.s_row)


def run(app, only):
    shutil.rmtree(WORK, ignore_errors=True)
    WORK.mkdir(parents=True)
    pages = guide()
    rows = ROWS + [f"M-{t['id']}" for p in pages for t in p["tutorials"]] + LATE_ROWS
    rows = [r for r in rows if not only or r in only]
    proof = Proof(app, pages)
    try:
        proof.launch("light")
        try:
            proof.light(only)
        finally:
            proof.stop()
        if not only or "S2" in only:
            proof.launch("dark")
            try:
                proof.dark(only)
            finally:
                proof.stop()
        if not only or "T1" in only:
            proof.t1()
    except (ToolError, OSError) as error:
        print(f"tutorial_chrome_proof: stopped by {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
    for rid in rows:
        if rid not in states:
            score(rid, False, "the row was never scored")
    passed = sum(1 for rid in rows if states[rid] == "pass")
    print(f"scores: {passed} pass, {len(rows) - passed} fail of {len(rows)}")
    return rows, passed


def mutant(name):
    file, anchor, replacement, killers = APP_MUTANTS[name]
    print(f"tutorial chrome — the {name} MUTANT ({', '.join(killers)} must FAIL)", flush=True)
    made, reason = tree_copy.make_copy(str(HERE / "work" / "tutorial_chrome_mutant"))
    if made is None:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {reason}")
        return 2
    source = Path(made) / "app/Sources" / file
    text = source.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if text.count(anchor) != 1:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — the anchor is in "
              f"{file} {text.count(anchor)}×")
        return 2
    source.write_text(text.replace(anchor, replacement), encoding="utf-8")
    app, reason = tree_copy.build_app(Path(made), 1500)
    if app is None:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {reason}")
        return 2
    run(proof_app.executable(app), set(killers))
    reached = [k for k in killers if k in states]
    if not reached:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — no killing row ran")
        return 2
    caught = [k for k in killers if states.get(k) == "fail"]
    print(f"{'MUTANT PASS' if caught else 'MUTANT FAILURE'}: {name} — "
          f"{', '.join(caught) or 'no killing row'} failed in the copy")
    return 0 if caught else 1


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--only", help="comma-separated row ids")
    parser.add_argument("--app", help="a .app or executable (default: proof_app's choice)")
    parser.add_argument("--mutant", choices=sorted(APP_MUTANTS))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mutant:
        return mutant(args.mutant)
    app = (proof_app.executable(Path(args.app)) if args.app and args.app.endswith(".app")
           else Path(args.app) if args.app else proof_app.binary())
    only = set(args.only.split(",")) if args.only else set()
    rows, passed = run(app, only)
    return 0 if passed == len(rows) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

def display(title):

def plain(text):
    """`TutorialSentence.plain`: a `` ` `` span runs to the next `` ` ``, a
    `**` span to the next `**`; an unpaired marker stays."""
    out, i = [], 0
    while i < len(text):
        if text[i] == "`":
            close = text.find("`", i + 1)
            if close != -1:
                out.append(text[i + 1:close])
                i = close + 1
                continue

            close = text.find("**", i + 2)

    rows, the four tabs and the seven sub-tabs."""

def intersect(a, b):
    if a is None or b is None:
        return None
    x0, y0 = max(a[0], b[0]), max(a[1], b[1])
    x1, y1 = min(a[0] + a[2], b[0] + b[2]), min(a[1] + a[3], b[1] + b[3])
    if x1 - x0 <= 0 or y1 - y0 <= 0:
        return None
    return [x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0]


def near(a, b):
    if a is None or b is None:
        return a is None and b is None
    return all(abs(p - q) <= TOL for p, q in zip(a, b))


def swift_round(x):
    return math.floor(x + 0.5) if x >= 0 else -math.floor(-x + 0.5)


class Dump:
    """A `snapshot_ui` layout dump: views by index, and frames in its root."""

    def __init__(self, result):
        self.result = result
        self.views = json.loads(Path(result["layout_path"]).read_text())["views"]
        self.size = result["points"]

    def shown(self, vid):
        return [v for v in self.views if v["id"] == vid and not v["hidden"]]

    def by_class(self, name):
        return [v for v in self.views if v["class"] == name and not v["hidden"]]

    def clipped(self, view, rect=None):
        """`rect` (default the view's frame) cut by every ancestor clip view."""
        r = list(rect or view["frame"])
        parent = view["parent"]
        while parent is not None and 0 <= parent < len(self.views):
            above = self.views[parent]
            if above["class"] in CLIP_VIEWS:
                r = intersect(r, above["frame"])
                if r is None:
                    return None
            if above["parent"] == parent:
                break
            parent = above["parent"]
        return r

    def expected(self, name):
        """The expected visible rect of a view target, or None."""
        found = self.shown(name)
        if not found:
            return None
        rect = self.clipped(found[0])
        if name == "timeline.clips" and rect is not None:
            ruler, headers = self.shown("ruler"), self.shown("timeline.headers")
            if ruler and headers:
                top = ruler[0]["frame"][1] + ruler[0]["frame"][3]
                left = headers[0]["frame"][0] + headers[0]["frame"][2]
                band = [left, top, 1e6, 1e6]
                rect = intersect(rect, band)

class Proof:
    def __init__(self, app, pages):

            str(self.app), arguments=["-RCDevAppearance", look] + PINS,
            env=bounded.child_env({"CFFIXED_USER_HOME": str(HOME)}), log_path=str(log),
            timeout=CALL_BOUND)
        self.client = self.launched.client
        self.look = look
        self.logs.append(log)
        if self.client is None:
            raise SystemExit(f"the {look} instance did not listen; its log is {log}")
        print(f"  instance ({look}) PID {self.launched.child.pid}", flush=True)

    def stop(self):
        if self.launched is not None:
            self.launched.stop()
            mcp.remove_scratch(self.launched.socket_path)
        self.launched = None
        self.client = None

    # ---- calls ----

    def call(self, tool, **arguments):
        return self.client.call_with(tool, arguments)

    def state(self, **arguments):
        return self.call("tutorial_state", **arguments)

    def press(self, button):
        return self.call("tutorial_press", button=button)

    def listing(self):
        return self.call("snapshot_ui")["windows"]

    def kinds(self):
        return [w["kind"] for w in self.listing()]

    def capture(self, window, name):
        CAPTURES.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path = CAPTURES / f"{self.look}-{name}.png"
        arguments = {"window": window, "path": str(path)}
        if window in ("editor", "sheet"):
            arguments["fill_preview"] = False
        result = self.client.call_with("snapshot_ui", arguments)
        return Dump(result), path

    def practice(self):
        self.call("new_project", practice=True)
        clips = sorted(self.call("get_project")["project"]["clips"],
                       key=lambda c: (c["start"], c["id"]))
        expect(len(clips) == 3, f"the practice copy holds {len(clips)} clips")
        self.ids = [c["id"] for c in clips]

    def menu_start(self, page_title, title):
        return self.call("perform_menu_item", path=["Help", "Tutorials", page_title, title])

    def tutorial(self, tid):
        for page in self.pages:
            for t in page["tutorials"]:
                if t["id"] == tid:
                    return page, t
        raise Check(f"the guide has no tutorial {tid}")

    def start(self, tid):
        page, t = self.tutorial(tid)
        return self.menu_start(page["title"], display(t["title"]))

    def settled(self, want_step=None, bound=3.0):
        """The state once the panel shows the runner's step (no tick, its
        progress the runner's), within `bound` seconds."""
        deadline = time.monotonic() + bound
        while True:
            got = self.state()
            panel = got.get("panel") or {}
            if got.get("running"):
                wanted = ("Finished" if got.get("finished")
                          else f"Step {got.get('step')} of {got.get('steps')}")
                if (not panel.get("tick") and panel.get("progress") == wanted
                        and (want_step is None or got.get("step") == want_step)):
                    return got
            if time.monotonic() > deadline:
                return got
            time.sleep(0.1)

    # ---- the row frame ----

    def row(self, rid, body, opener="practice"):
        detail, ok, opened = None, False, False
        try:
            if opener == "practice":
                self.practice()
            elif opener == "empty":
                self.call("new_project")
                self.ids = []
            opened = opener is not None
            detail = body()
            ok = True
        except Check as failure:
            detail = str(failure)
        except (ToolError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, IndexError, OSError) as error:
            detail = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
        if opened:
            try:
                self.close_all()
            except ToolError as error:
                ok = False
                detail = f"{detail}; the close was refused: {error}"
        score(rid, ok, detail)

    def close_all(self):
        """Closes every editor (after cancel_sheet where a sheet is up); a
        refused close raises."""
        for _ in range(6):
            editors = [w for w in self.listing() if w["kind"] == "editor"]
            if not editors:
                return
            if any(w.get("sheet") for w in editors):
                try:
                    self.call("cancel_sheet")
                except ToolError:
                    pass
            self.call("close_project", discard=True)

    # ---- comparisons ----

    def compare_target(self, name, dump, got):
        """`got` (a target or ring answer) against the dump's expectation."""
        want = dump.expected(name)
        rect = got.get("rect")
        if want is None:
            expect(rect is None and got.get("reason"),
                   f"{name}: rect {rect}, reason {got.get('reason')!r}; the dump shows nothing")
        else:
            expect(near(rect, want), f"{name}: rect {rect}, the dump's {want}")
        return want

    def ring_matches(self, step_name, got, tid, k):
        """The ring against the dump and the staged ring in its capture."""
        ring = got.get("ring") or {}
        expect(ring.get("target") == got.get("spotlight"),
               f"step {k}: ring target {ring.get('target')}, spotlight {got.get('spotlight')}")
        if not ring.get("shown"):
            expect(ring.get("rect") is None or got.get("spotlight") is None or True,
                   "unreachable")
            return "ring hidden" + (f" ({ring.get('reason')})" if ring.get("reason") else "")
        window = ring.get("window")
        expect(window in ("editor", "sheet"), f"step {k}: ring window {window}")
        dump, _ = self.capture(window, f"{tid}-{k}")
        again = self.state()
        ring = again.get("ring") or ring
        name = got["spotlight"]
        self.compare_target(name, dump, ring)
        staged = dump.shown("tutorial.spotlight")
        expect(len(staged) == 1, f"step {k}: {len(staged)} staged rings in the capture")
        r = ring["rect"]
        outset = [r[0] - 4, r[1] - 4, r[2] + 8, r[3] + 8]
        want = intersect(outset, [0, 0, dump.size[0], dump.size[1]])
        expect(near(staged[0]["frame"], want),
               f"step {k}: staged ring {staged[0]['frame']}, want {want}")
        return f"ring on {name} in the {window}"

    # ---- T1 ----

    def t1(self):
        lines = []
        for log in self.logs:
            try:
                lines += [l for l in log.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()
                          if "Frame Job: " in l]
            except OSError as error:
                lines.append(f"{log}: {error}")
        score("T1", not lines, f"no `Frame Job: ` line in {len(self.logs)} logs"
              if not lines else f"{lines[:2]}")

    # ---- H1 ----

    def h1(self):
        listing = self.call("perform_menu_item")
        items = listing.get("items") or listing.get("leaves") or []
        paths = [i["path"] for i in items if i["path"][:2] == ["Help", "Tutorials"]]
        want = [["Help", "Tutorials", p["title"], display(t["title"])]
                for p in self.pages for t in p["tutorials"]]
        want.append(["Help", "Tutorials", "Open Practice Project"])
        expect(paths == want, f"Help ▸ Tutorials lists {paths}, want {want}")
        return f"{len(want) - 1} tutorials under {len(self.pages)} pages, then Open Practice Project"

    # ---- K1 ----

    def k1(self):
        dawn = self.ids[0]
        self.call("set_selection", clips=[dawn])
        shown = self.call("select_inspector_tab", tab="clip", sub_tab="sound")
        offered = shown.get("sub_tabs") or []
        dump, _ = self.capture("editor", "k1-editor")
        names = [n for n in fixed_names() if not n.startswith(SHEET_PREFIX)]
        sections = [v["id"] for v in dump.views if (v["id"] or "").startswith("section:")]
        expect(sections, "the Sound pane shows no section in the dump")
        clipped = []
        tabs = dump.by_class("PanelTabsView")
        subs = dump.by_class("ClipSubTabsView")
        expect(tabs and subs, f"{len(tabs)} tab strips, {len(subs)} sub-tab strips in the dump")
        for name in names + sections + ["clip:$selection"]:
            got = self.state(target=name)["target"]
            expect(got["name"] == name, f"asked {name}, answered {got['name']}")
            if name.startswith("inspector.tab."):
                index = ["clip", "media", "document", "assistant"].index(name.split(".")[-1])
                x, y, w, h = tabs[0]["frame"]
                width = w / 4
                left, right = swift_round(index * width), swift_round((index + 1) * width)
                want = dump.clipped(tabs[0], [x + left, y, right - left, h])
                expect(near(got["rect"], want), f"{name}: {got['rect']}, the strip's {want}")
            elif name.startswith("inspector.sub_tab."):
                sub = name.split(".")[-1]
                if sub not in offered:
                    expect(got["rect"] is None and got["reason"],
                           f"{name}: un-offered, answered {got['rect']} {got['reason']!r}")
                    continue
                x, y, w, h = subs[0]["frame"]
                step = (w - 2 * 10 - 1) / len(offered)
                i = offered.index(sub)
                left = 10 + swift_round(i * step)
                right = 10 + swift_round((i + 1) * step) + 1
                want = dump.clipped(subs[0], [x + left, y + 8, right - left, 24])
                expect(near(got["rect"], want), f"{name}: {got['rect']}, the strip's {want}")
            elif name == "clip:$selection":
                lanes = dump.expected("timeline.clips")
                r = got["rect"]
                expect(r is not None and r[2] > 0 and r[3] > 0, f"{name}: rect {r}")
                expect(intersect(r, lanes) is not None and near(intersect(r, lanes), r),
                       f"{name}: {r} not inside timeline.clips {lanes}")
            else:
                want = self.compare_target(name, dump, got)
                if name.startswith("section:"):
                    frame = dump.shown(name)[0]["frame"] if dump.shown(name) else None
                    if want is None or not near(want, frame):
                        clipped.append(name)
        expect(clipped, "precondition: no Sound section is clipped or hidden")
        print(f"    K1 precondition: clipped or hidden {clipped}", flush=True)
        self.call("perform_menu_item", path=["File", "Export…"])
        sheet, _ = self.capture("sheet", "k1-sheet")
        sheet_names = [n for n in fixed_names() if n.startswith(SHEET_PREFIX)]
        for name in sheet_names:
            got = self.state(target=name)["target"]
            expect(got["window"] == "sheet" or got["rect"] is None,
                   f"{name}: window {got['window']}")
            self.compare_target(name, sheet, got)
        self.call("cancel_sheet")
        return (f"{len(names)} fixed names, {len(sections)} Sound sections, clip:$selection and "
                f"{len(sheet_names)} sheet controls match the dump; clipped {clipped}")

    # ---- M rows ----

    def m_row(self, tid):
        started = self.start(tid)
        opened = [w["kind"] for w in started.get("windows_opened", [])]
        expect("tutorial" in opened, f"the menu start opened {opened}")
        notes, presses = [], 0
        sheet_steps = set()
        export_id = None
        while presses < 12:
            got = self.settled()
            expect(got.get("running"), f"not running: {got}")
            panel = got["panel"]
            if got.get("finished"):
                break
            k, n = got["step"], got["steps"]
            expect(panel["mode"] == "step" and panel["progress"] == f"Step {k} of {n}",
                   f"step {k}: panel {panel['mode']} {panel['progress']!r}")
            expect(panel["text"] == plain(got["text"]),
                   f"step {k}: text {panel['text']!r}, want {plain(got['text'])!r}")
            expect(panel["buttons"] == got["offers"],
                   f"step {k}: buttons {panel['buttons']}, offers {got['offers']}")
            notes.append(self.ring_matches(got["spotlight"], got, tid, k))
            if (got.get("ring") or {}).get("window") == "sheet":
                sheet_steps.add(k)
            action = next(a for a in ("show_me", "next", "skip") if a in got["offers"])
            answer = self.press(action)
            presses += 1
            last = answer.get("last_show_me") or {}
            if action == "show_me":
                expect(last.get("ok") is True, f"step {k}'s Show Me failed: {last.get('error')}")
                if last.get("paths"):
                    try:
                        export_id = json.loads(last["results"][-1]).get("export_id")
                    except (ValueError, IndexError, AttributeError):
                        export_id = None
        got = self.settled()
        panel = got["panel"]
        expect(got.get("finished") and panel["mode"] == "finished"
               and panel["buttons"] == ["back", "exit"],
               f"the end: finished {got.get('finished')}, panel {panel['mode']} "
               f"{panel['buttons']}")
        if tid == "export.range":
            expect(sheet_steps == {4, 5}, f"the ring was in the sheet at steps {sheet_steps}")
            want = "Show Me exports to ~/Movies/Frame Job Tutorial.mp4."
            expect(panel["message"] == want, f"finished message {panel['message']!r}")
            expect(export_id is not None, "no export id in the Show Me's results")
            self.client.wait_export(export_id, seconds=180)
            written = HOME / "Movies" / "Frame Job Tutorial.mp4"
            expect(written.exists() and written.stat().st_size > 0, f"{written} not written")
        return f"{presses} presses to the finish; " + "; ".join(notes)

    # ---- the other rows ----

    def at_step2(self):
        self.start("audio.volume")
        self.call("set_selection", clips=[self.ids[0]])
        got = self.settled(want_step=2)
        expect(got.get("step") == 2 and not got["panel"]["tick"],
               f"volume is at step {got.get('step')}, tick {got['panel']['tick']}")
        return got

    def tk1(self):
        self.start("audio.volume")
        first = self.settled(want_step=1)
        expect(first.get("step") == 1, f"started at step {first.get('step')}")
        self.call("set_selection", clips=[self.ids[0]])
        ticked = self.state()["panel"]
        expect(ticked["tick"] is True and ticked["progress"] == "Step 1 of 3",
               f"after the selection: tick {ticked['tick']}, {ticked['progress']!r}")
        expect(ticked["enabled"] == [], f"buttons enabled during the tick: {ticked['enabled']}")
        time.sleep(1.5)
        later = self.state()["panel"]
        expect(later["tick"] is False and later["progress"] == "Step 2 of 3",
               f"1.5 s later: tick {later['tick']}, {later['progress']!r}")
        return "the tick held step 1 with every button off, then step 2"

    def w1(self):
        got = self.at_step2()
        dump, _ = self.capture("editor", "w1-before")
        ring = self.state()["ring"]
        expect(ring["target"] == "section:audio.volume", f"ring target {ring['target']}")
        before = self.compare_target("section:audio.volume", dump, ring)
        self.call("select_inspector_tab", section="audio.mix")
        time.sleep(0.3)
        dump2, _ = self.capture("editor", "w1-after")
        ring2 = self.state()["ring"]
        after = self.compare_target("section:audio.volume", dump2, ring2)
        expect(after is None or not near(before, after),
               f"the scroll did not move audio.volume ({before} → {after})")
        return (f"ring {ring['rect']} → {ring2['rect']} "
                f"({ring2.get('reason') or 'moved'}); step {got['step']}")

    def c1(self):
        self.start("audio.volume")
        panel = self.call("tutorial_state")["panel"]
        expect(panel["mode"] == "offer" and panel["text"] == VOLUME_NEEDS
               and panel["message"] == OFFER_LINE
               and panel["buttons"] == ["open_practice", "close"],
               f"the offer: {panel}")
        self.press("open_practice")
        got = self.settled()
        expect(got.get("running") and got.get("id") == "audio.volume"
               and got.get("step") in (1, 2) and got["panel"]["mode"] == "step",
               f"after open_practice: running {got.get('running')} {got.get('id')} step "
               f"{got.get('step')} panel {got['panel']['mode']}")
        clips = self.call("get_project")["project"]["clips"]
        expect(len(clips) == 3, f"the front project holds {len(clips)} clips, not the copy's 3")
        return f"offered, then the practice copy runs audio.volume at step {got['step']}"

    def c2(self):
        self.close_all()
        self.start("canvas.add_title")
        dump, _ = self.capture("tutorial", "c2-offer")
        text = [v["text"] for v in dump.shown("tutorial.text")]
        buttons = [v["id"] for v in dump.views
                   if (v["id"] or "").startswith("tutorial.") and v["class"] == "StickerButton"
                   and not v["hidden"]]
        expect(text == [NO_WINDOW], f"the offer's text {text}")
        expect(buttons == ["tutorial.open_practice", "tutorial.close"],
               f"the offer's buttons {buttons}")
        self.press("close")
        kinds = self.kinds()
        expect("tutorial" not in kinds, f"after close the listing holds {kinds}")
        return "offered with no window; Close took the panel down"

    def e1(self):
        self.start("audio.volume")
        self.settled()
        before = self.call("get_project")
        self.press("exit")
        got = self.state()
        kinds = self.kinds()
        after = self.call("get_project")
        expect(got.get("running") is False, "still running after exit")
        expect("tutorial" not in kinds and "spotlight" not in kinds, f"listing {kinds}")
        expect(before["project"] == after["project"], "get_project changed across the exit")
        return "running false, no panel or ring, the project unchanged"

    def e2(self):
        self.start("audio.volume")
        self.settled()
        self.call("close_project", discard=True)
        kinds = self.kinds()
        expect("tutorial" not in kinds and "spotlight" not in kinds, f"listing {kinds}")
        return "closing the project took the panel and the ring down"

    def f1(self):
        self.start("audio.volume")
        self.settled()
        self.press("show_me")
        self.settled()
        rows = [w for w in self.listing() if w["kind"] == "tutorial"]
        expect(len(rows) == 1 and rows[0]["key"] is False and rows[0]["main"] is False,
               f"tutorial rows {rows}")
        return "the panel is neither key nor main after a press"

    def s_row(self):
        self.at_step2()
        panel, ppath = self.capture("tutorial", "s-panel")
        editor, epath = self.capture("editor", "s-editor")
        for path in (ppath, epath):
            width, channels, rows = decode_png(path.read_bytes(), upto=400)
            first = bytes(rows[0][:channels])
            uniform = all(bytes(r[i:i + channels]) == first
                          for r in rows for i in range(0, len(r), channels))
            expect(not uniform, f"{path.name} is one colour")
        expect(panel.result.get("problems") == [], f"panel problems {panel.result.get('problems')}")
        expect(panel.result.get("appearance") == self.look,
               f"panel appearance {panel.result.get('appearance')}")
        expect(editor.shown("tutorial.spotlight"), "the editor capture holds no staged ring")
        return f"{ppath.name} and {epath.name} not uniform; the panel {self.look}, no problems"

    # ---- all ----

    def light(self, only):
        def wanted(rid):
            return not only or rid in only

        if wanted("H1"):
            self.row("H1", self.h1, opener=None)
        if wanted("K1"):
            self.row("K1", self.k1)
        for page in self.pages:
            for t in page["tutorials"]:
                rid = f"M-{t['id']}"
                if wanted(rid):
                    self.row(rid, lambda tid=t["id"]: self.m_row(tid))
        table = [("TK1", self.tk1, "practice"), ("W1", self.w1, "practice"),
                 ("C1", self.c1, "empty"), ("C2", self.c2, None), ("E1", self.e1, "practice"),
                 ("E2", self.e2, "practice"), ("F1", self.f1, "practice"),
                 ("S1", self.s_row, "practice")]
        for rid, body, opener in table:
            if wanted(rid):
                self.row(rid, body, opener)

    def dark(self, only):
        if not only or "S2" in only:
            self.row("S2", self.s_row)


def run(app, only):
    shutil.rmtree(WORK, ignore_errors=True)
    WORK.mkdir(parents=True)
    pages = guide()
    rows = ROWS + [f"M-{t['id']}" for p in pages for t in p["tutorials"]] + LATE_ROWS
    rows = [r for r in rows if not only or r in only]
    proof = Proof(app, pages)
    try:
        proof.launch("light")
        try:
            proof.light(only)
        finally:
            proof.stop()
        if not only or "S2" in only:
            proof.launch("dark")
            try:
                proof.dark(only)
            finally:
                proof.stop()
        if not only or "T1" in only:
            proof.t1()
    except (ToolError, OSError) as error:
        print(f"tutorial_chrome_proof: stopped by {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
    for rid in rows:
        if rid not in states:
            score(rid, False, "the row was never scored")
    passed = sum(1 for rid in rows if states[rid] == "pass")
    print(f"scores: {passed} pass, {len(rows) - passed} fail of {len(rows)}")
    return rows, passed


def mutant(name):
    file, anchor, replacement, killers = APP_MUTANTS[name]
    print(f"tutorial chrome — the {name} MUTANT ({', '.join(killers)} must FAIL)", flush=True)
    made, reason = tree_copy.make_copy(str(HERE / "work" / "tutorial_chrome_mutant"))
    if made is None:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {reason}")
        return 2
    source = Path(made) / "app/Sources" / file
    text = source.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if text.count(anchor) != 1:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — the anchor is in "
              f"{file} {text.count(anchor)}×")
        return 2
    source.write_text(text.replace(anchor, replacement), encoding="utf-8")
    app, reason = tree_copy.build_app(Path(made), 1500)
    if app is None:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {reason}")
        return 2
    run(proof_app.executable(app), set(killers))
    reached = [k for k in killers if k in states]
    if not reached:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — no killing row ran")
        return 2
    caught = [k for k in killers if states.get(k) == "fail"]
    print(f"{'MUTANT PASS' if caught else 'MUTANT FAILURE'}: {name} — "
          f"{', '.join(caught) or 'no killing row'} failed in the copy")
    return 0 if caught else 1


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--only", help="comma-separated row ids")
    parser.add_argument("--app", help="a .app or executable (default: proof_app's choice)")
    parser.add_argument("--mutant", choices=sorted(APP_MUTANTS))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mutant:
        return mutant(args.mutant)
    app = (proof_app.executable(Path(args.app)) if args.app and args.app.endswith(".app")
           else Path(args.app) if args.app else proof_app.binary())
    only = set(args.only.split(",")) if args.only else set()
    rows, passed = run(app, only)
    return 0 if passed == len(rows) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Tutorials TU3 — the chrome: Help ▸ Tutorials, the coach panel, the
spotlight's ring and the practice offer, proved against the built app (spec
§11 TU-10, TU-11).

    python3 tools/proof/tutorial_chrome_proof.py [--only ID,…] [--app PATH]
    python3 tools/proof/tutorial_chrome_proof.py --mutant NAME

**The instances.** The built app (`proof_app`'s choice, `RC_PROOF_APP`),
launched by this script in a scratch home
(`CFFIXED_USER_HOME=tools/proof/work/tutorial_chrome/home`, whose `Movies/`
is removed and made empty before every launch, so Show Me's first free name
is always `Frame Job Tutorial.mp4`) on a scratch socket, with
`-FrameJobTimelineHeight 560 -FrameJobInspectorWidth 304` (argument-domain
pins: nothing is written, and the inspector is short enough that the Sound
pane overflows), stopped by its PID: once with `-RCDevAppearance light` for
every row, then once with `-RCDevAppearance dark` for the S rows. No
persisting View item is performed and no section is toggled. Every row but
C2 runs on a fresh project and ends with `close_project {discard: true}`
(after `cancel_sheet` when a sheet is up); a refused close FAILS the row.
The practice clips are Dawn, Sea and Night, 6 s each on Track 1.

**The expectations** come from the guide: `tools/tutorials/tutorial_extract.py`
(the build step's own extractor) writes `Tutorials.json` into the work
folder; a title is shown with its first character uppercased; a sentence's
plain text drops `**` and `` ` `` markers as `TutorialSentence.plain` does
(re-implemented here). A view target's expected rect is its id's frame in
`snapshot_ui`'s layout dump (`fill_preview false`) intersected with every
ancestor `NSClipView`'s frame — for `timeline.clips` also with its top raised
to the `ruler`'s bottom and its left to the `timeline.headers`' right — or no
rect with a reason exactly when that is empty; ±0.5 pt.

- **T1** — no `Frame Job: ` line in either instance's log.
- **H1** — `perform_menu_item`'s listing: under Help ▸ Tutorials, the guide's
  page titles in file order, each holding its tutorials' titles, then Open
  Practice Project last.
- **K1** — on the practice project, Dawn selected, Clip ▸ Sound shown:
  `tutorial_state {target}` for every non-sheet fixed name, every Sound
  section and `clip:$selection`, then File ▸ Export… and the nine
  `sheet.export.*`, each against the dump; tabs and Dawn's offered sub-tabs
  against the strips' arithmetic, an un-offered sub-tab no rect with a reason;
  `clip:$selection` inside `timeline.clips`; at least one Sound section
  clipped or hidden (precondition, printed).
- **M-<id>** — each of the five started by `perform_menu_item [Help,
  Tutorials, <page>, <title>]` on the practice project (its
  `windows_opened` holds a `tutorial` row); per step, once the panel shows
  the runner's step (≤ 3 s): mode step, `Step k of n`, the text the runner's
  plain, the buttons its offers in order; the ring's target the step's
  spotlight, and when shown its rect the dump's and the capture's staged
  `tutorial.spotlight` that rect outset by 4 and cut to the capture's root;
  then `tutorial_press` show_me, else next, else skip. Export a range: steps
  4–5's ring in the `sheet`, the finished message `Show Me exports to
  ~/Movies/Frame Job Tutorial.mp4.`, the export waited for. Each ends
  finished with `[back, exit]`.
- **TK1** — volume at step 1, `set_selection` Dawn: the next state's panel
  ticks at `Step 1 of 3`; 1.5 s later, no tick and `Step 2 of 3`.
- **W1** — volume at step 2: the ring against the dump; then
  `select_inspector_tab {section: audio.mix}` scrolls the pane and the ring
  against the new dump (moved, or no rect with a reason).
- **C1** — on `new_project {}`, the menu start of `audio.volume` is an offer
  (`This tutorial needs a clip that has sound.`, the offer line, `[open_practice,
  close]`); `open_practice` opens a practice copy running `audio.volume`.
- **C2** — every project closed, the menu start of `canvas.add_title` is an
  offer with `This tutorial runs in a project window.` (read from
  `snapshot_ui window tutorial`'s dump); `close` leaves no `tutorial` row.
- **E1** — `exit` mid-tutorial: `running` false, no `tutorial` or
  `spotlight` row, `get_project` unchanged.
- **E2** — `close_project` while running: no `tutorial` or `spotlight` row.
- **F1** — after the presses, the listing's `tutorial` row is neither key nor
  main.
- **S1** / **S2** — light / dark: `snapshot_ui window tutorial` and `window
  editor` with the ring up (volume step 2): PNGs not uniform, the panel's
  `problems` empty, its `appearance` the look, the editor's dump holding the
  staged ring.

`--mutant NAME` builds a copy of the tree with one decision broken
(`APP_MUTANTS`), runs its killing rows on it and passes when one of them
FAILS (0), fails when all pass (1), and answers 2 when the control could not
be performed.

Rows print as `<ID> pass|fail — <detail>`, then `scores:`. Exit 0 iff no row
failed.

def display(title):

def plain(text):
    """`TutorialSentence.plain`: a `` ` `` span runs to the next `` ` ``, a
    `**` span to the next `**`; an unpaired marker stays."""
    out, i = [], 0
    while i < len(text):
        if text[i] == "`":
            close = text.find("`", i + 1)
            if close != -1:
                out.append(text[i + 1:close])
                i = close + 1
                continue
        if text.startswith("**", i):
            close = text.find("**", i + 2)
            if close != -1:
                out.append(text[i + 2:close])
                i = close + 2
                continue
        out.append(text[i])
        i += 1
    return "".join(out)


def guide():

def fixed_names():
    """`TutorialTargets.fixed`'s names, read from the source: the literal
    rows, the four tabs and the seven sub-tabs."""
    text = (ROOT / "app/Sources/TutorialTargets.swift").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    names = re.findall(r'^\s*"([a-z0-9_.]+)": "the ', text, re.M)
    pinned = (ROOT / "app/Sources/ClipPinnedBlock.swift").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    subs = re.search(r"enum ClipSubTab: String, CaseIterable \{\s*case ([a-z, ]+)\n", pinned)
    tabs = ["clip", "media", "document", "assistant"]
    return (names + [f"inspector.tab.{t}" for t in tabs]
            + [f"inspector.sub_tab.{s.strip()}" for s in subs.group(1).split(",")])


# ---- geometry ------------------------------------------------------------------


def intersect(a, b):
    if a is None or b is None:
        return None
    x0, y0 = max(a[0], b[0]), max(a[1], b[1])
    x1, y1 = min(a[0] + a[2], b[0] + b[2]), min(a[1] + a[3], b[1] + b[3])
    if x1 - x0 <= 0 or y1 - y0 <= 0:
        return None
    return [x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0]


def near(a, b):
    if a is None or b is None:
        return a is None and b is None
    return all(abs(p - q) <= TOL for p, q in zip(a, b))


def swift_round(x):
    return math.floor(x + 0.5) if x >= 0 else -math.floor(-x + 0.5)


class Dump:
    """A `snapshot_ui` layout dump: views by index, and frames in its root."""

    def __init__(self, result):
        self.result = result
        self.views = json.loads(Path(result["layout_path"]).read_text())["views"]
        self.size = result["points"]

    def shown(self, vid):
        return [v for v in self.views if v["id"] == vid and not v["hidden"]]

    def by_class(self, name):
        return [v for v in self.views if v["class"] == name and not v["hidden"]]

    def clipped(self, view, rect=None):
        """`rect` (default the view's frame) cut by every ancestor clip view."""
        r = list(rect or view["frame"])
        parent = view["parent"]
        while parent is not None and 0 <= parent < len(self.views):
            above = self.views[parent]
            if above["class"] in CLIP_VIEWS:
                r = intersect(r, above["frame"])
                if r is None:
                    return None
            if above["parent"] == parent:
                break
            parent = above["parent"]
        return r

    def expected(self, name):
        """The expected visible rect of a view target, or None."""
        found = self.shown(name)
        if not found:
            return None
        rect = self.clipped(found[0])
        if name == "timeline.clips" and rect is not None:
            ruler, headers = self.shown("ruler"), self.shown("timeline.headers")
            if ruler and headers:
                top = ruler[0]["frame"][1] + ruler[0]["frame"][3]
                left = headers[0]["frame"][0] + headers[0]["frame"][2]
                band = [left, top, 1e6, 1e6]
                rect = intersect(rect, band)
        return rect

class Proof:
    def __init__(self, app, pages):
        self.app = app
        self.pages = pages
        self.client = None
        self.launched = None
        self.look = None
        self.logs = []

    # ---- the instance ----

    def launch(self, look):
        HOME.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.rmtree(HOME / "Movies", ignore_errors=True)
        (HOME / "Movies").mkdir()
        log = WORK / f"framejob-{look}.log"
        if log.exists():
            log.unlink()
        self.launched = mcp.launch(
            str(self.app), arguments=["-RCDevAppearance", look] + PINS,
            env=bounded.child_env({"CFFIXED_USER_HOME": str(HOME)}), log_path=str(log),
            timeout=CALL_BOUND)
        self.client = self.launched.client
        self.look = look
        self.logs.append(log)
        if self.client is None:
            raise SystemExit(f"the {look} instance did not listen; its log is {log}")
        print(f"  instance ({look}) PID {self.launched.child.pid}", flush=True)

    def stop(self):
        if self.launched is not None:
            self.launched.stop()
            mcp.remove_scratch(self.launched.socket_path)
        self.launched = None
        self.client = None

    # ---- calls ----

    def call(self, tool, **arguments):
        return self.client.call_with(tool, arguments)

    def state(self, **arguments):
        return self.call("tutorial_state", **arguments)

    def press(self, button):
        return self.call("tutorial_press", button=button)

    def listing(self):
        return self.call("snapshot_ui")["windows"]

    def kinds(self):
        return [w["kind"] for w in self.listing()]

    def capture(self, window, name):
        CAPTURES.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path = CAPTURES / f"{self.look}-{name}.png"
        arguments = {"window": window, "path": str(path)}
        if window in ("editor", "sheet"):
            arguments["fill_preview"] = False
        result = self.client.call_with("snapshot_ui", arguments)
        return Dump(result), path

    def practice(self):
        self.call("new_project", practice=True)
        clips = sorted(self.call("get_project")["project"]["clips"],
                       key=lambda c: (c["start"], c["id"]))
        expect(len(clips) == 3, f"the practice copy holds {len(clips)} clips")
        self.ids = [c["id"] for c in clips]

    def menu_start(self, page_title, title):
        return self.call("perform_menu_item", path=["Help", "Tutorials", page_title, title])

    def tutorial(self, tid):
        for page in self.pages:
            for t in page["tutorials"]:
                if t["id"] == tid:
                    return page, t
        raise Check(f"the guide has no tutorial {tid}")

    def start(self, tid):
        page, t = self.tutorial(tid)
        return self.menu_start(page["title"], display(t["title"]))

    def settled(self, want_step=None, bound=3.0):
        """The state once the panel shows the runner's step (no tick, its
        progress the runner's), within `bound` seconds."""
        deadline = time.monotonic() + bound
        while True:
            got = self.state()
            panel = got.get("panel") or {}
            if got.get("running"):
                wanted = ("Finished" if got.get("finished")
                          else f"Step {got.get('step')} of {got.get('steps')}")
                if (not panel.get("tick") and panel.get("progress") == wanted
                        and (want_step is None or got.get("step") == want_step)):
                    return got
            if time.monotonic() > deadline:
                return got
            time.sleep(0.1)

    # ---- the row frame ----

    def row(self, rid, body, opener="practice"):
        detail, ok, opened = None, False, False
        try:
            if opener == "practice":
                self.practice()
            elif opener == "empty":
                self.call("new_project")
                self.ids = []
            opened = opener is not None
            detail = body()
            ok = True
        except Check as failure:
            detail = str(failure)
        except (ToolError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, IndexError, OSError) as error:
            detail = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
        if opened:
            try:
                self.close_all()
            except ToolError as error:
                ok = False
                detail = f"{detail}; the close was refused: {error}"
        score(rid, ok, detail)

    def close_all(self):
        """Closes every editor (after cancel_sheet where a sheet is up); a
        refused close raises."""
        for _ in range(6):
            editors = [w for w in self.listing() if w["kind"] == "editor"]
            if not editors:
                return
            if any(w.get("sheet") for w in editors):
                try:
                    self.call("cancel_sheet")
                except ToolError:
                    pass
            self.call("close_project", discard=True)

    # ---- comparisons ----

    def compare_target(self, name, dump, got):
        """`got` (a target or ring answer) against the dump's expectation."""
        want = dump.expected(name)
        rect = got.get("rect")
        if want is None:
            expect(rect is None and got.get("reason"),
                   f"{name}: rect {rect}, reason {got.get('reason')!r}; the dump shows nothing")
        else:
            expect(near(rect, want), f"{name}: rect {rect}, the dump's {want}")
        return want

    def ring_matches(self, step_name, got, tid, k):
        """The ring against the dump and the staged ring in its capture."""
        ring = got.get("ring") or {}
        expect(ring.get("target") == got.get("spotlight"),
               f"step {k}: ring target {ring.get('target')}, spotlight {got.get('spotlight')}")
        if not ring.get("shown"):
            expect(ring.get("rect") is None or got.get("spotlight") is None or True,
                   "unreachable")
            return "ring hidden" + (f" ({ring.get('reason')})" if ring.get("reason") else "")
        window = ring.get("window")
        expect(window in ("editor", "sheet"), f"step {k}: ring window {window}")
        dump, _ = self.capture(window, f"{tid}-{k}")
        again = self.state()
        ring = again.get("ring") or ring
        name = got["spotlight"]
        self.compare_target(name, dump, ring)
        staged = dump.shown("tutorial.spotlight")
        expect(len(staged) == 1, f"step {k}: {len(staged)} staged rings in the capture")
        r = ring["rect"]
        outset = [r[0] - 4, r[1] - 4, r[2] + 8, r[3] + 8]
        want = intersect(outset, [0, 0, dump.size[0], dump.size[1]])
        expect(near(staged[0]["frame"], want),
               f"step {k}: staged ring {staged[0]['frame']}, want {want}")
        return f"ring on {name} in the {window}"

    # ---- T1 ----

    def t1(self):
        lines = []
        for log in self.logs:
            try:
                lines += [l for l in log.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()
                          if "Frame Job: " in l]
            except OSError as error:
                lines.append(f"{log}: {error}")
        score("T1", not lines, f"no `Frame Job: ` line in {len(self.logs)} logs"
              if not lines else f"{lines[:2]}")

    # ---- H1 ----

    def h1(self):
        listing = self.call("perform_menu_item")
        items = listing.get("items") or listing.get("leaves") or []
        paths = [i["path"] for i in items if i["path"][:2] == ["Help", "Tutorials"]]
        want = [["Help", "Tutorials", p["title"], display(t["title"])]
                for p in self.pages for t in p["tutorials"]]
        want.append(["Help", "Tutorials", "Open Practice Project"])
        expect(paths == want, f"Help ▸ Tutorials lists {paths}, want {want}")
        return f"{len(want) - 1} tutorials under {len(self.pages)} pages, then Open Practice Project"

    # ---- K1 ----

    def k1(self):
        dawn = self.ids[0]
        self.call("set_selection", clips=[dawn])
        shown = self.call("select_inspector_tab", tab="clip", sub_tab="sound")
        offered = shown.get("sub_tabs") or []
        dump, _ = self.capture("editor", "k1-editor")
        names = [n for n in fixed_names() if not n.startswith(SHEET_PREFIX)]
        sections = [v["id"] for v in dump.views if (v["id"] or "").startswith("section:")]
        expect(sections, "the Sound pane shows no section in the dump")
        clipped = []
        tabs = dump.by_class("PanelTabsView")
        subs = dump.by_class("ClipSubTabsView")
        expect(tabs and subs, f"{len(tabs)} tab strips, {len(subs)} sub-tab strips in the dump")
        for name in names + sections + ["clip:$selection"]:
            got = self.state(target=name)["target"]
            expect(got["name"] == name, f"asked {name}, answered {got['name']}")
            if name.startswith("inspector.tab."):
                index = ["clip", "media", "document", "assistant"].index(name.split(".")[-1])
                x, y, w, h = tabs[0]["frame"]
                width = w / 4
                left, right = swift_round(index * width), swift_round((index + 1) * width)
                want = dump.clipped(tabs[0], [x + left, y, right - left, h])
                expect(near(got["rect"], want), f"{name}: {got['rect']}, the strip's {want}")
            elif name.startswith("inspector.sub_tab."):
                sub = name.split(".")[-1]
                if sub not in offered:
                    expect(got["rect"] is None and got["reason"],
                           f"{name}: un-offered, answered {got['rect']} {got['reason']!r}")
                    continue
                x, y, w, h = subs[0]["frame"]
                step = (w - 2 * 10 - 1) / len(offered)
                i = offered.index(sub)
                left = 10 + swift_round(i * step)
                right = 10 + swift_round((i + 1) * step) + 1
                want = dump.clipped(subs[0], [x + left, y + 8, right - left, 24])
                expect(near(got["rect"], want), f"{name}: {got['rect']}, the strip's {want}")
            elif name == "clip:$selection":
                lanes = dump.expected("timeline.clips")
                r = got["rect"]
                expect(r is not None and r[2] > 0 and r[3] > 0, f"{name}: rect {r}")
                expect(intersect(r, lanes) is not None and near(intersect(r, lanes), r),
                       f"{name}: {r} not inside timeline.clips {lanes}")
            else:
                want = self.compare_target(name, dump, got)
                if name.startswith("section:"):
                    frame = dump.shown(name)[0]["frame"] if dump.shown(name) else None
                    if want is None or not near(want, frame):
                        clipped.append(name)
        expect(clipped, "precondition: no Sound section is clipped or hidden")
        print(f"    K1 precondition: clipped or hidden {clipped}", flush=True)
        self.call("perform_menu_item", path=["File", "Export…"])
        sheet, _ = self.capture("sheet", "k1-sheet")
        sheet_names = [n for n in fixed_names() if n.startswith(SHEET_PREFIX)]
        for name in sheet_names:
            got = self.state(target=name)["target"]
            expect(got["window"] == "sheet" or got["rect"] is None,
                   f"{name}: window {got['window']}")
            self.compare_target(name, sheet, got)
        self.call("cancel_sheet")
        return (f"{len(names)} fixed names, {len(sections)} Sound sections, clip:$selection and "
                f"{len(sheet_names)} sheet controls match the dump; clipped {clipped}")

    # ---- M rows ----

    def m_row(self, tid):
        started = self.start(tid)
        opened = [w["kind"] for w in started.get("windows_opened", [])]
        expect("tutorial" in opened, f"the menu start opened {opened}")
        notes, presses = [], 0
        sheet_steps = set()
        export_id = None
        while presses < 12:
            got = self.settled()
            expect(got.get("running"), f"not running: {got}")
            panel = got["panel"]
            if got.get("finished"):
                break
            k, n = got["step"], got["steps"]
            expect(panel["mode"] == "step" and panel["progress"] == f"Step {k} of {n}",
                   f"step {k}: panel {panel['mode']} {panel['progress']!r}")
            expect(panel["text"] == plain(got["text"]),
                   f"step {k}: text {panel['text']!r}, want {plain(got['text'])!r}")
            expect(panel["buttons"] == got["offers"],
                   f"step {k}: buttons {panel['buttons']}, offers {got['offers']}")
            notes.append(self.ring_matches(got["spotlight"], got, tid, k))
            if (got.get("ring") or {}).get("window") == "sheet":
                sheet_steps.add(k)
            action = next(a for a in ("show_me", "next", "skip") if a in got["offers"])
            answer = self.press(action)
            presses += 1
            last = answer.get("last_show_me") or {}
            if action == "show_me":
                expect(last.get("ok") is True, f"step {k}'s Show Me failed: {last.get('error')}")
                if last.get("paths"):
                    try:
                        export_id = json.loads(last["results"][-1]).get("export_id")
                    except (ValueError, IndexError, AttributeError):
                        export_id = None
        got = self.settled()
        panel = got["panel"]
        expect(got.get("finished") and panel["mode"] == "finished"
               and panel["buttons"] == ["back", "exit"],
               f"the end: finished {got.get('finished')}, panel {panel['mode']} "
               f"{panel['buttons']}")
        if tid == "export.range":
            expect(sheet_steps == {4, 5}, f"the ring was in the sheet at steps {sheet_steps}")
            want = "Show Me exports to ~/Movies/Frame Job Tutorial.mp4."
            expect(panel["message"] == want, f"finished message {panel['message']!r}")
            expect(export_id is not None, "no export id in the Show Me's results")
            self.client.wait_export(export_id, seconds=180)
            written = HOME / "Movies" / "Frame Job Tutorial.mp4"
            expect(written.exists() and written.stat().st_size > 0, f"{written} not written")
        return f"{presses} presses to the finish; " + "; ".join(notes)

    # ---- the other rows ----

    def at_step2(self):
        self.start("audio.volume")
        self.call("set_selection", clips=[self.ids[0]])
        got = self.settled(want_step=2)
        expect(got.get("step") == 2 and not got["panel"]["tick"],
               f"volume is at step {got.get('step')}, tick {got['panel']['tick']}")
        return got

    def tk1(self):
        self.start("audio.volume")
        first = self.settled(want_step=1)
        expect(first.get("step") == 1, f"started at step {first.get('step')}")
        self.call("set_selection", clips=[self.ids[0]])
        ticked = self.state()["panel"]
        expect(ticked["tick"] is True and ticked["progress"] == "Step 1 of 3",
               f"after the selection: tick {ticked['tick']}, {ticked['progress']!r}")
        expect(ticked["enabled"] == [], f"buttons enabled during the tick: {ticked['enabled']}")
        time.sleep(1.5)
        later = self.state()["panel"]
        expect(later["tick"] is False and later["progress"] == "Step 2 of 3",
               f"1.5 s later: tick {later['tick']}, {later['progress']!r}")
        return "the tick held step 1 with every button off, then step 2"

    def w1(self):
        got = self.at_step2()
        dump, _ = self.capture("editor", "w1-before")
        ring = self.state()["ring"]
        expect(ring["target"] == "section:audio.volume", f"ring target {ring['target']}")
        before = self.compare_target("section:audio.volume", dump, ring)
        self.call("select_inspector_tab", section="audio.mix")
        time.sleep(0.3)
        dump2, _ = self.capture("editor", "w1-after")
        ring2 = self.state()["ring"]
        after = self.compare_target("section:audio.volume", dump2, ring2)
        expect(after is None or not near(before, after),
               f"the scroll did not move audio.volume ({before} → {after})")
        return (f"ring {ring['rect']} → {ring2['rect']} "
                f"({ring2.get('reason') or 'moved'}); step {got['step']}")

    def c1(self):
        self.start("audio.volume")
        panel = self.call("tutorial_state")["panel"]
        expect(panel["mode"] == "offer" and panel["text"] == VOLUME_NEEDS
               and panel["message"] == OFFER_LINE
               and panel["buttons"] == ["open_practice", "close"],
               f"the offer: {panel}")
        self.press("open_practice")
        got = self.settled()
        expect(got.get("running") and got.get("id") == "audio.volume"
               and got.get("step") in (1, 2) and got["panel"]["mode"] == "step",
               f"after open_practice: running {got.get('running')} {got.get('id')} step "
               f"{got.get('step')} panel {got['panel']['mode']}")
        clips = self.call("get_project")["project"]["clips"]
        expect(len(clips) == 3, f"the front project holds {len(clips)} clips, not the copy's 3")
        return f"offered, then the practice copy runs audio.volume at step {got['step']}"

    def c2(self):
        self.close_all()
        self.start("canvas.add_title")
        dump, _ = self.capture("tutorial", "c2-offer")
        text = [v["text"] for v in dump.shown("tutorial.text")]
        buttons = [v["id"] for v in dump.views
                   if (v["id"] or "").startswith("tutorial.") and v["class"] == "StickerButton"
                   and not v["hidden"]]
        expect(text == [NO_WINDOW], f"the offer's text {text}")
        expect(buttons == ["tutorial.open_practice", "tutorial.close"],
               f"the offer's buttons {buttons}")
        self.press("close")
        kinds = self.kinds()
        expect("tutorial" not in kinds, f"after close the listing holds {kinds}")
        return "offered with no window; Close took the panel down"

    def e1(self):
        self.start("audio.volume")
        self.settled()
        before = self.call("get_project")
        self.press("exit")
        got = self.state()
        kinds = self.kinds()
        after = self.call("get_project")
        expect(got.get("running") is False, "still running after exit")
        expect("tutorial" not in kinds and "spotlight" not in kinds, f"listing {kinds}")
        expect(before["project"] == after["project"], "get_project changed across the exit")
        return "running false, no panel or ring, the project unchanged"

    def e2(self):
        self.start("audio.volume")
        self.settled()
        self.call("close_project", discard=True)
        kinds = self.kinds()
        expect("tutorial" not in kinds and "spotlight" not in kinds, f"listing {kinds}")
        return "closing the project took the panel and the ring down"

    def f1(self):
        self.start("audio.volume")
        self.settled()
        self.press("show_me")
        self.settled()
        rows = [w for w in self.listing() if w["kind"] == "tutorial"]
        expect(len(rows) == 1 and rows[0]["key"] is False and rows[0]["main"] is False,
               f"tutorial rows {rows}")
        return "the panel is neither key nor main after a press"

    def s_row(self):
        self.at_step2()
        panel, ppath = self.capture("tutorial", "s-panel")
        editor, epath = self.capture("editor", "s-editor")
        for path in (ppath, epath):
            width, channels, rows = decode_png(path.read_bytes(), upto=400)
            first = bytes(rows[0][:channels])
            uniform = all(bytes(r[i:i + channels]) == first
                          for r in rows for i in range(0, len(r), channels))
            expect(not uniform, f"{path.name} is one colour")
        expect(panel.result.get("problems") == [], f"panel problems {panel.result.get('problems')}")
        expect(panel.result.get("appearance") == self.look,
               f"panel appearance {panel.result.get('appearance')}")
        expect(editor.shown("tutorial.spotlight"), "the editor capture holds no staged ring")
        return f"{ppath.name} and {epath.name} not uniform; the panel {self.look}, no problems"

    # ---- all ----

    def light(self, only):
        def wanted(rid):
            return not only or rid in only

        if wanted("H1"):
            self.row("H1", self.h1, opener=None)
        if wanted("K1"):
            self.row("K1", self.k1)
        for page in self.pages:
            for t in page["tutorials"]:
                rid = f"M-{t['id']}"
                if wanted(rid):
                    self.row(rid, lambda tid=t["id"]: self.m_row(tid))
        table = [("TK1", self.tk1, "practice"), ("W1", self.w1, "practice"),
                 ("C1", self.c1, "empty"), ("C2", self.c2, None), ("E1", self.e1, "practice"),
                 ("E2", self.e2, "practice"), ("F1", self.f1, "practice"),
                 ("S1", self.s_row, "practice")]
        for rid, body, opener in table:
            if wanted(rid):
                self.row(rid, body, opener)

    def dark(self, only):
        if not only or "S2" in only:
            self.row("S2", self.s_row)


def run(app, only):
    shutil.rmtree(WORK, ignore_errors=True)
    WORK.mkdir(parents=True)
    pages = guide()
    rows = ROWS + [f"M-{t['id']}" for p in pages for t in p["tutorials"]] + LATE_ROWS
    rows = [r for r in rows if not only or r in only]
    proof = Proof(app, pages)
    try:
        proof.launch("light")
        try:
            proof.light(only)
        finally:
            proof.stop()
        if not only or "S2" in only:
            proof.launch("dark")
            try:
                proof.dark(only)
            finally:
                proof.stop()
        if not only or "T1" in only:
            proof.t1()
    except (ToolError, OSError) as error:
        print(f"tutorial_chrome_proof: stopped by {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
    for rid in rows:
        if rid not in states:
            score(rid, False, "the row was never scored")
    passed = sum(1 for rid in rows if states[rid] == "pass")
    print(f"scores: {passed} pass, {len(rows) - passed} fail of {len(rows)}")
    return rows, passed


def mutant(name):
    file, anchor, replacement, killers = APP_MUTANTS[name]
    print(f"tutorial chrome — the {name} MUTANT ({', '.join(killers)} must FAIL)", flush=True)
    made, reason = tree_copy.make_copy(str(HERE / "work" / "tutorial_chrome_mutant"))
    if made is None:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {reason}")
        return 2
    source = Path(made) / "app/Sources" / file
    text = source.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if text.count(anchor) != 1:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — the anchor is in "
              f"{file} {text.count(anchor)}×")
        return 2
    source.write_text(text.replace(anchor, replacement), encoding="utf-8")
    app, reason = tree_copy.build_app(Path(made), 1500)
    if app is None:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — {reason}")
        return 2
    run(proof_app.executable(app), set(killers))
    reached = [k for k in killers if k in states]
    if not reached:
        print(f"mutant {name}: the control could not be performed — no killing row ran")
        return 2
    caught = [k for k in killers if states.get(k) == "fail"]
    print(f"{'MUTANT PASS' if caught else 'MUTANT FAILURE'}: {name} — "
          f"{', '.join(caught) or 'no killing row'} failed in the copy")
    return 0 if caught else 1


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--only", help="comma-separated row ids")
    parser.add_argument("--app", help="a .app or executable (default: proof_app's choice)")
    parser.add_argument("--mutant", choices=sorted(APP_MUTANTS))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mutant:
        return mutant(args.mutant)
    app = (proof_app.executable(Path(args.app)) if args.app and args.app.endswith(".app")
           else Path(args.app) if args.app else proof_app.binary())
    only = set(args.only.split(",")) if args.only else set()
    rows, passed = run(app, only)
    return 0 if passed == len(rows) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

bound" table claims no row for it and every bare letter belongs to the
editor's own `keyDown`; the queue's window sets
`isExcludedFromWindowsMenu`, since this menu is `NSApp.windowsMenu` and
AppKit would otherwise list it a second time under its own title — Bring All
to Front), Help (Frame Job Help; Tutorials ▸, holding Open Practice Project,
which opens the bundled practice project as an untitled copy, with no key
equivalent and no document needed — §11 TU-7; road map "tutorials"'s TU3 puts
one submenu per guide page above it; Graphics Reference — road map 10's G5b: the
bundled `GraphicsAPI.md` opened in the person's own app, live while the
bundle holds it, with no document needed).
Road map 10's G5b adds **Insert**, right after Edit, and File gains **Add
rate — `rate` 1, 2 or 4, default 1 — through `Playback.setRate`, and sleeps
`seconds` (0.5…60) on the server thread; with `seek_to` (ticks, snapped to the
frame grid) it sleeps half, notes the playhead (`seek_from`), seeks through
the asked door (`Playback.seek(to:)`, as a click on the ruler does) and sleeps
the rest. `stale_ticks` (a non-empty list of ticks ≥ 0, issue #329) hands the
seek's prefetch session requests it must not follow, through
`GraphicPrefetch.reach`, the compositor's own call: in the seek's own main
hop, where the session is already installed and not yet armed, or, with
`stale_armed: true`, once a frame in the seek's first `armFrames` (4) frames
was composed (so its request armed the session), polled every 10 ms for at
most min(2 s, `seconds` / 2) from the seek; the second half still ends
`seconds` / 2 after the seek, the wait included. Then it notes `to` and
pauses. While it plays,
`PlaybackTrial.swift` records each frame the compositor finished on the
document's key: its time, its compose time, and, with `digests: true`, the
SHA-256 of the destination buffer's rows (each row's first `width × 8`
bytes, 64RGBAHalf). It answers, keys in this order: `from`, `to`, `rate`,
`wall_seconds`, `frame_ticks` (f, the built composition's frame duration),
`frames_expected` (max(0, k1 − k0 + 1), k0 = ⌊from / f⌋ — ⌊seek_to / f⌋ with
`seek_to` — and k1 = ⌊(to − 1) / f⌋), `frames_composed` (the distinct ⌊t / f⌋
in [k0, k1] among the frames served), `composed_ratio` (3 places; 0 when none
were expected), `compose_ms {mean, p95, worst}` (nearest rank, over every
frame served), `seek_from` (only with `seek_to`), `stale_reached` (only with
`stale_ticks`: the ticks reported — all of them, or `[]` when the armed wait
ran out) and `digests` (only when asked: a tick string → SHA-256 hex).
Refused, each in its own sentence and before anything moves: `stale_ticks`
without `seek_to`, an empty `stale_ticks`, a negative tick, and
`stale_armed` without `stale_ticks`. Refused, each in its own sentence: a
project with no editor window and a preview with no item to play, changing
nothing, and a preview still seeking after 5 s, which it has paused. It ends
paused where the play reached. It is
`playback_prefetch_proof.py`'s instrument.
**`graphic_memory {pressure?}`** (issue #127, §11 G-37) answers the graphic
rasters' one memory budget and the frames a document keeps. It needs no
project and runs off the main thread. `pressure` — `"normal"`, `"warning"` or
`"critical"`, any other value refused in its own sentence before anything
moves — first sets a SIMULATED memory-pressure level, which holds against the
system's real events until the tool sets `"normal"`; that clears the
simulation and applies the last real level. It answers `physical_bytes`
(`ProcessInfo.physicalMemory`), `budget_bytes` (a quarter of it at normal, an
eighth at warning, 0 at critical), `pressure` (the level in force),
`held_bytes` (every session's rasters held ahead now), `held_peak_bytes` and
`held_peak_entries` (the highest totals since the last answer, which resets
them to the current ones), `kept_bytes` and `kept_frames` (the kept frames'
total and count, over every document), `kept_hits` (how many compositor
requests the kept frames have answered since launch), `ahead_bytes` (the kept
frames a background pass drew ahead that the compositor has not passed, §11
G-38), `ahead_evicted` (those a trim pushed out while still ahead, since the
last answer, which resets it to 0), `pass_activity` (whether a running
background pass holds the App Nap opt-out), `image_cache_bytes` (what the
engine's decoded-image cache of PNG and JPEG assets holds, §11 G-39) and
`image_cache_limit` (its limit: `budget_bytes / 16`, 0 under
`FrameJobGraphicImageCacheOff`). It is `graphic_memory_proof.py`'s,
`background_render_proof.py`'s and `image_cache_proof.py`'s instrument.
**`tutorial_start {id}`, `tutorial_state {}`, `tutorial_step {action}` and
`tutorial_exit {}`** (Tutorials TU2, §11 TU-8, TU-9) drive a project editor
window's tutorial runner with no chrome. `tutorial_start` starts the bundled
`Tutorials.json`'s tutorial `id` there, replacing any running, and is refused
with the needs sentence when no clip meets its `needs`, naming the tutorials
for an unknown id and giving the model's reason for one it does not read.
`tutorial_step`'s `action` is `show_me` (runs the step's Show Me and answers
once it has finished, waiting up to 60 s off the main thread without the
lane's lock), `next` (a step with no wait), `back` (the step before, or the
last once finished; no evaluation) or `skip` (an optional step), each refused
in the runner's own sentence when the step does not offer it.
`tutorial_exit` ends it, undoing nothing. Every answer but a refusal is the
state: `ok`, `project`, `running`, and while running `id`, `title`, `step`
(1-based), `steps`, `text`, `optional`, `wait` and `show_me` (whether the step
has them), `offers` (of `back`, `show_me`, `skip`, `next`, `exit`, in that
order), `spotlight`, `reveal` (`{tab, sub_tab, section}` or null),
`reveal_refused`, `finished`, `show_me_running`, `last_show_me` (`{step, ok,
error, results, paths}` or null — each call's result text, and the files an
`export` call was sent to write), `selection_at_start`, `created` and
`completed` (`[{step, by}]`, `by` one of `wait`, `next`, `skip`). A project
with no editor window is refused as `select_inspector_tab` refuses it. A wait
met by `tutorial_start`'s own entry advances on a later main turn, so the
start answers step 1 and the next call sees the advance. They are
`tutorial_proof.py`'s instrument.

**The transport is spec §11 MC-1..MC-6** (road map 14,
`designs/adr/roadmap-14-agent-socket.md`): the server listens only on a Unix socket,
`~/Library/Application Support/Frame Job/Agent/agent.sock`, at every launch
(MC-1), bound by the first instance and only in its own `0700` `Agent`
subfolder the person owns (MC-2); an external client reaches it through
`framejob-mcp`, the bundle's stdio server (MC-3), which answers `initialize`
and `tools/list` without launching Frame Job and launches it in the background
on the first `tools/call` that finds no socket (MC-4); a tool call never
raises a modal question (MC-5); and `RC_AGENT_SOCKET` overrides the path,
which every proof sets (MC-6). The socket is bound at every launch
(`AgentServer+Socket.swift`) and is the only listener: road map 14's MC4
deleted the TCP one, its switch and MC-6's interim rule. A tool call decides
"may ask" where it hands work to the importer, so a person's own import
still asks while a call runs (MC-5). Settings' MCP section's Copy MCP
Command (MC-7) puts the `claude mcp add` line for the bundle's own
`framejob-mcp` on the clipboard; it is not an edit, so it has no tool.

is the first. With no `window` it lists the visible windows (kind, class,
title, frame, content size, scale, occluded, key, main, the editor's project,

the call) — it captures through `cacheDisplay` (V-3), which needs neither an
active app nor a visible window, as an image block plus a JSON text block
and a PNG on disk; `view` narrows the editor to `toolbar`, `preview`,
`inspector` or `timeline`; `appearance` is REFUSED whatever its value,
naming the launch-time way (road map 11's V3: a live switch left the colours a
view took when it was built in the launch appearance, so the picture was a mix
the app never draws) — the look is the instance's, set at launch by the
dev-only default `-RCDevAppearance light|dark`, which puts `NSApp.appearance`
before any window is built, and every capture answers the `appearance` it drew
in (a second dev-only default, `-RCDevLookGalleryDump <folder>`, has the Look
gallery write each completed generation of thumbnails to
`<folder>/<N>/<tile>.png` — `none`, the kind, or `lut-<media id>` for an imported
LUT's tile (§11 GR-8) — then `<folder>/<N>/manifest.json`
`{generation, t, clips, missing, tiles}`, last, `tiles` the tile names in the
gallery's order; §11 GR-7); `fill_preview` (default true) puts `render_frame`'s picture at the
playhead under the canvas overlay for the capture and takes it out after;

# Frame Job User Guide

Frame Job is a native macOS video editor for Apple Silicon Macs running
macOS 26 or later. You open a movie, arrange it on layered tracks over a fixed
canvas, then trim, cut, grade, caption, animate and export it. Every edit you
make in the window can also be made by an AI agent over MCP, or by the built-in
Assistant.

The quickest way in: **File ▸ Open…** (⌘O) on a movie makes an untitled project
sized and timed to it, with the movie on Track 1, ready to cut. Save writes a
`.framejob` package.

## The pages

Read the first four in order to learn the editor; the rest stand alone.

1. [Projects and media](projects-and-media.md) — starting, saving and opening projects, the `.framejob` package, the Document tab's canvas settings, importing files, the Media tab and relinking.
2. [The timeline and playback](timeline.md) — the editor window, tracks and their switches, the ruler and playhead, zoom, selection, snapping, markers, the in/out range and playback.
3. [Editing clips](editing.md) — placing, moving, trimming, slipping, splitting, deleting and closing gaps, copy and paste, and nests.
4. [Canvas, layers, text and shapes](canvas-and-layers.md) — placing a picture on the canvas, opacity, blend modes, shadows and filters, text, shape, image and background clips, and matte tracks.
5. [Motion, actions and transitions](motion-and-transitions.md) — actions that animate a clip's properties over time, motion presets, and transitions between clips.
6. [Speed, reverse and freeze frames](speed.md) — constant speed, fitting a clip to a length, rate stretch, speed ramps and their presets, reversing and freeze frames.
7. [Audio](audio.md) — clip levels, fades, ducking, noise reduction, compression, pan, mute and solo, Normalize and Synchronize Audio.
8. [Remove Silences and Remove Filler Words](cleanup-tools.md) — cutting dead air and filler words out of a spoken recording in one step.
9. [Captions and transcription](captions.md) — importing and exporting captions, and transcribing speech on this Mac or with AssemblyAI into subtitles or word-by-word captions.
10. [Colour grading](color-grading.md) — the Color tab, wheels, curves, looks and LUTs, adjustment clips and qualifiers, Show Ungraded and the scopes.
11. [HDR and colour management](hdr-and-color.md) — how sources are read, camera log, SDR and HDR (HLG) projects, blending, and HDR and SDR deliverables.
12. [Motion graphics](graphics.md) — graphic clips, the built-in graphics, their properties in the inspector, and bringing in your own.
13. [Screen recording](screen-recording.md) — recording a display or a window with system audio, microphone and click rings, recording a camera on its own or beside the screen, and recording voice-overs.
14. [Exporting](export.md) — the export sheet, its formats and settings, presets, the Export Queue, and saving single frames.
15. [The Assistant](assistant.md) — chatting with Claude in the inspector to edit the open project, on your own Anthropic key.
16. [Driving Frame Job from an AI agent (MCP)](mcp.md) — connecting an MCP client such as Claude Code, how calls behave, and every tool.
17. [Settings](settings.md) — the Settings window, updates (Check for Updates… in the downloaded copy), the View choices Frame Job remembers, and where it keeps its files.
18. [Menus and keyboard shortcuts](menus-and-shortcuts.md) — every menu command with its shortcut, and the keys, gestures and context menus that have no menu item.

Writing your own graphic module is covered by the
[graphics API reference](../graphics-api.md).
